evidence.note: ReBalance is a training-free inference-time steering method that reads a reasoning model's token confidence to detect overthinking or underthinking and applies a hidden-state steering vector to shorten or extend the chain of thought accordingly.
evidence.title: Efficient Reasoning with Balanced Thinking

evidence.note: TrimR is a training-free, verifier-based system that trims redundant chain-of-thought reasoning in deployed large reasoning models to speed up test-time scaling with little accuracy loss.
evidence.title: TrimR: Verifier-based Training-Free Thinking Trimming for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
